methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In this code we use a linear regression model to predict the remaining lifespan of a fuel cell/battery system, based on the input data collected.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The proposed monitoring/tool architecture includes a prognostic model for component remaining life, not an identifiable EnPI or EnB measurement/normalisation model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this section we will present a system that monitors in real time the performance of a hybrid fuel cell/battery system, using artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) algorithms to predict the system's behaviors and optimize its operation.

stage1.notes: The model predicts remaining component life; the paper does not identify an energy-use baseline, normalisation relation, or EnPI construction.
